proposed_widenings.name: GrantSenseOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: Detect Magic grants the caster a persistent magical sense (detect magic within 30 ft) while concentrating. The ongoing_effect family is structurally correct, but OngoingOperation = RollModifierOperation | DamageOnHitOperation — neither covers a sense-granting effect. The v4 atom grant_sense exists in the taxonomy; it needs an OngoingOperation variant to expose it on the surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself.

proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime.minutes with ritual flag
proposed_widenings.justification: Detect Magic can be cast as a Ritual (10-minute cast, no slot expended). The existing CastingTime minutes variant already supports the ritual flag (ritual: boolean). This is already present in the surface — no new variant needed. Noted here for completeness.

notes: The ongoing_effect family is the right shape: concentration up to 10 min, self attachment, passive persistent operation. The sole blocking gap is OngoingOperation missing a grant_sense variant. The secondary mechanic (take the Magic action while concentrating to see auras + learn spell school) requires a conditioned sub-action pattern not currently on the surface; the school-identification output is DM-informational and caller-owned per ARCHITECTURE.md — omit from core. The ritual casting path already has surface support via CastingTime.minutes { ritual: true }. Not classified as dm_agenda because the sensing state itself is mechanically deterministic (range-gated, material-blocked); only the reported output is informational.
